messages:
sam-sales: FYI ACME (enterprise) just greenlit a POC to migrate from AtlasAI. They want a drop-in experience but called out output drift and token spend as blockers. Can we scope? :eyes:

maria-pm: Nice — do we have the AtlasAPI spec + a sample corpus from them? Need to know exact endpoints and expected response shapes.

kevin-ml: They mentioned hallucinations. We'll want prompt parity tests + a small eval harness. Ask for 200 representative prompts and expected labels (or golden responses).

alex-eng: For a drop-in, we can provide a lightweight bridge that translates Atlas request fields -> Redwood API and normalizes responses. Quick sketch:```json
// mapping example
{"atlas_input":"prompt","max_tokens":128} -> {"input":"prompt","tokens_limit":128}
```
This avoids changing their client.

sam-sales: Perfect. Also they asked about per-token pricing parity and an enterprise discount during the POC window. Who handles pricing?

maria-pm: I'll own the commercial ask. Proposal: free POC credits + committed capacity pricing if they exceed X qps. I'll draft numbers and send to legal.

jenna-sec: Heads-up: ACME requires completion of our standard security questionnaire + evidence of network isolation. Can we commit to a short turn-around? They also asked about SOC2 scope.

kevin-ml: For model parity, two items: 1) match decoding settings (temp, top_p, stop tokens) 2) response normalization hooks (strip vendor-specific metadata, canonicalize JSON). We should log diffs and surface failure examples.

alex-eng: Agree. We'll add a response-normalization layer that can run a small rule set and a fallback mapping for any schema mismatches. Also suggest we enable prefix/KV cache to reduce token consumption for repeated prompts.

sam-sales: Are there any feature gaps vs AtlasAPI? They use streaming with incremental JSON chunks and a proprietary rerank endpoint.

alex-eng: Streaming: supported. We'll implement chunked JSON events identical to Atlas' wire format for the POC. Rerank: we have reranking support but endpoint signature differs — bridge will translate payload and return Atlas-shaped output.

kevin-ml: Also test for subtle deltas: completion length heuristics, tokenizer boundary differences, and any model quantization artifacts — put these in the eval harness.

jenna-sec: I'll start the security questionnaire. Please upload any network diagrams, SOC2 cert, and data retention policies to the shared folder. CI-bot will ping when docs are uploaded.

ci-bot: Reminder: please upload files to /shared/sales/acme-poc within 48h or questionnaire blockers will delay kickoff.

maria-pm: Action items: (1) sam: get Atlas API spec + 200 prompts from ACME, (2) alex: prototype bridge mapping & stream shim, (3) kevin: eval harness and parity tests, (4) jenna: run security questionnaire. I'll coordinate pricing and legal.

sam-sales: All noted. I'll email ACME for the corpus + spec today and loop them in. Target: POC start next week.

alex-eng: Quick note on rollout — recommend canary at 5% traffic to verify parity, automatic fallback to Redwood-hosted model if mismatch rate > 3% for 1 minute.

kevin-ml: I'll add regression alerts tied to prompt set and a daily diff report.

jenna-sec: If ACME needs an on-prem/private deployment for compliance, flag now — that impacts timelines.

sam-sales: Mentioned they prefer hosted first but will escalate to VPC if SOC requests. I'll update.

maria-pm: Great. I'll set up a short weekly sync (30m) to track blockers. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:

sam-sales: thanks — assigning owners in the thread.
